description: Fina is a Enforcers Daughter, she's been harshly trained by her father all her life. On the night of the change, to which you could find your soul mate- Fina finds hers. He's of course the soon to be Alpha, however he doesn't want her. Its not sweat off Fina's back, she's more worried about her Family finding out then being rejected. Her feet carry her to a deeper part of the forest, one she shouldn't of gone into. When things twist and stories become a reality Fina will have to pick what side she wants to be part of.

description: Alexzandria (Alex) Parker had a difficult family life. Her dads an alcoholic who's never home. Her mom commuted suicide when Alex was three. Her brother, he seems to be a bit to overprotected with some anger issues. So when school starts up again it seems like that is the light of her day, until she meets him. The guy she never thought she could have. He can make her smile and have a meaning to life. But there's one thing, he's her teacher. Will that keep them apart or will they find a way to be together?

Meet Cory And Conner Shaw- Her Next Door Neighbors. They're The Top Dogs Of The High School- Parties, Casual Sex, Drinking, Girls. They Are The Most Popular Guys, And The Definition Of Players. So... What Happens When The Infallible Cory Shaw Starts Taking A Specific Interest In Kyleigh?

Insert Cassie Sanders. The IT Girl. The Main Bitch. She's Jealous, And Out To Make Kyleigh's Life Hell, One Way Or Another.

Will Kyleigh Make It Through Cassie's Reign Of Bitchiness? Will Cory Ever Get His Chance, Or Will He Be Written Off As Just A Heartbreaker? 

Read Now, And Lose Yourself!

description:
Hi, my name is Bella, and I'm just the ordinary teenage girl. Um, WRONG! I'm a mermaid. Yeah, you read it right. A mermaid. I live off the coast of Hawaii where sailors come and go.

Oh, and no, I'm not some creepy siren who drags men out to sea. I'm just a peaceful little mermaid.

Anyways, one day while coming close to the shore, I saw a very attractive young boy surfing. And when a wave took him under and he didn't come up, I swam to him and rescued him.. And I'm pretty sure he saw me before he blacked out. 

Woops.

description:
The five heroes. They all have their story ending but what if their stories continue...together?

They have their lives. Elsa is unhappy. Merida frustrated. Jack is bored. Rapunzel's free. Hiccup is no longer underestimated.

But what if Manny decides to bring them together? 

Will they fall in love? 

Even if some of them are from the past? 

Will the new guardians except their challenge?

Pitch is back. But this time his stronger... along with a few nightmares from the heroes haunting past. 

He knows their secrets...and their feelings for each other.

Will he use it to hes advantage?

Do they have why it takes to accept love and defeat fear?

- Si jamais l'un de nous apprends que tu l'as touché, tu auras à faire à nous tous.
_________________________________________________________________________________

description:
Connor Murphy, 17, a weed addict, depressed, abusive (at times), a jerk, outcast. Connor hates everything and everyone, his outlook on life is all black and white, he hates school, rather smoke pot than be with people. 
Aria Snow, 17, silent, artistic, writer, calm, kind, introvert and a singer. Aria's always been moving her whole life. Her last year at school, in a whole new place. Her mom finally found a stable job so here she is. In New York. 
Connor and Aria's paths cross at Hopkins High School, Connor sees Aria and tries to get her attention. Here's the thing, she's deaf. When Connor turns to his window and sees the girl,  things change for the greater good.

Hidupku yang indah tiba tiba berubah gara gara aku bertemu dengan seorang pria angkuh dan menyebalkan..semua itu berawal dari kecerobohanku yang tidak sengaja menumpahkan juice strawberry pisang kesukaanku ke setelan jas mahal milik seorang pria menyebalkan yang hari itu juga langsung aku ikrarkan sebagai musuh terbesarku.

Belum cukup kegilaan yang aku hadapi..ternyata pria sombong tersebut adalah salah satu investor yang menanamkan sahamnya di hotel baru milikku..yang aku bangun berkat dukungan ayah.

Tidak!!dia memang tidak membatalkan kontrak kerja ataupun menarik investasinya..namun lebih parah dari itu..dia seolah mencari kesalahanku membuatku merasa muak dengannya..bertemu dengannya selalu membuat darahku mendidih..aku ingin sekali mencabik cabiknya..aku akan membuatnya menyesal karena mengusik hidupku..jangan panggil aku Park Sooyoung jika tidak bisa membuat seorang Yook Sungjae menyesali perbuatannya!!!!!

description:
I Had Everything.

Everything I ever wanted was right in between my hands.

But...

One day, I messed up..

No, you messed up.

It was the day I lost it all..

The day you broke my heart into a million pieces, making me regret. So much.

I saw him, a different him.

He wasn't the same,
he wasn't the one who I used to know.
Who I used to love.

"...how fucking could you?!"

I ran away with tears steaming down my cheeks,
trying to forget him.

Park Jimin.

Am I that replaceable?

---------------------------------------
[ Not Completed ]

As chapters go along,
the story itself might change.

description:
Roses are Red. Violets are Red. 
Lavender and lemons and oranges are Red.
Fury is Red. Cunning is Red. Deceitful and determined and dauntless is Red.
But afraid is Red. Lost is Red. Missing and wishing and hoping is Red.
~
Red is a closed book, one that no one in Tulsa can seem read. Ponyboy and the others rarely dig up clues from her past life - except that she hasn't had enough to live a normal one. All Red has done for the past two years is travel, searching for the missing puzzle piece in her life. Can Ponyboy figure her out...before she decides to move on?
5,589.

''There will be no Zhan Qing Lian anymore as my existence is a threaten to my family . I want to be the one protecting, not a burden.''

An -eight - year old girl chose her life to live as a man not to be woman.

''Our general is the god of war but ... He likes beauties''

The general who is said to be the god of war lost the battle in Qin qiao war. Will he be caught by the enemy or not? Who is the betrayer?

" Go and take a look who is there in the river"
Her body is full of wounds . Let take her to ben wang ye's home
 
Who am I? 

Who is she? 

I don't care who you are. I care only the love between you and me.

What will they choose? Their motherland or love.
Will they able to make the right choice?
Will their love last forever?
As both of them have the desire to protect the country.
What will happen at the end? 

This is my first time of writing. There will be some mistakes in my story. I hope all of you enjoy.

description:
He's psychotic, mad in the head, and shivers at the sweet taste of flesh. 

All Jeff desired was the perfect kill. A victim to fight back, give him a challenge, and amuse his sick cravings. He found who he was looking for, but was she too feisty, even for his taste? Too accustomed to his being there? When Jeff realizes this, he doesn't know whether to end her or not. The option is tempting, but there's something deeper to this story. Something that prohibits his inner murderer from stabbing her lifeless.

He begins to feel something sick, even sicker than all the blood shed and fear he's caused, the longer he's met with those green, nostalgic eyes.

He begins to remember.

500 years ago, I met a powerful shaman, one with a haughty personality. 500 years ago, I suffered my first lost, something I refused to acknowledge. 500 years ago, I fell inlove with the wrong person, something that I so deeply regret. 

Another 500 years later, I woke up with a new body, disoriented and confused. I met that man again. Even after 500 years, nothing has changed but he did became more obssess and power hungry. I don't want to omit the same mistake. This time, I'll make sure to correct every wrong thing that has happened in the past. 

That is, until I met his other half.  Things couldn't get any worse than this.  

Ugh.  Why God? Do you really hate me? 

♦️♥️♣️♠️

This is the story of a girl who knows too much.

sa isang WELSTON UNIVERSITY  ay may 4 na transfer at 4 na badboy ay kung saan magkakalaban ang boys and girls.. kumbaga ang mga boys ang KILALANG KAAWAY ANG MGA GIRLS ..... meron din silang sariling katangiang taglay pero ito at mababangis.

meet Chantelle Kyrzza Quintos , ang pinaka masungit sa kanilang apat , mayaman , matalino ,  mahilig mag suot ng mga pangsexy na damit at higit sa lahat volleyball player.   . Kathleen Marie Ang, matalino ,mabait, weird at mahilig magbasa ng mga libro. Ayanna Joy Thirllwall , mabait , mahilig sa make up at mga maiigsing damit . Fiona Bianca Ferriol , magaling kumanta at talented sa kanilang apat.


Yuan Mendoza , ang pinaka badboy ng WELSTON UNIVERSITY , matalino , laging nakasimangot , mayaman ,  Pinakakinakatakutan sa buong campus , WALANG PAKELAM SA MUNDO , Player ng basketball , heartthrob , mahilig uminom ng alak , naninigarilyo at higit sa lahat basagulero.



Joaquin Miguel Delos Santos , mahilig mambabae , at katulad din ni yuan , matalino, basketball player at PINAKA WOMANIZER.




Clodd Roel Hernandez ,  laging may pagkain , isip bata magisip , laging nakasalamin na nerd, mayaman , at matalino pero gangster.



Llanz Steven Espinosa ,  laging nakangiti at tumatawa , mejo masungit sa mga babae , mahilig din uminom at makipag away .




what if magkatagpo sila? magiging masaya ba sila sa unang pagpasok nila ng WELSTON UNIVERSITY?

The were destined to find them together.

Two people, are both finding the truth beneath their dimension. Yuna, dreams about a guy, who is killing her father in her dreams. The next day, he saw Dan kala niya ay siya yung pumatay sa tatay niya dun sa dream niya so, she investigate him first to make sure if he is the one on her's dream.


But she didn't know that, the guy is also trying find the truth about his family. She also didn't know that he is from a different dimension.

Yuna, is trying to figure it out his identity. While Dan, is trying to figure it out about his lost family.

Will they both succeed? Will they tried to find the truth? Or wasn't it just all a lie from the end?

And lastly.. will they fall in love with each other?

Are they connected somehow? Sinadya ba talaga ng tadhana ang pagkikita nila sa isa't isa? Dahil lang sa katotohanan? 

What if somehow Dan was the guy in her dreams. Will her feelings still accept him? Even though siya ang may dahilan ng pagkamatay ng tatay niya dun sa panaginip niya?

Let's see. Let their story begin

description:
When her four year old daughter informs her a sick man is in their yard, Honor Gillette rushes out to help him. But that "sick" man turns out to be Lee Coburn, the man accused of murdering seven people the night before. Dangerous, desperate, and armed, he promises Honor that she and her daughter won't be hurt as long as she does everything he asks. She has no choice but to accept him at his word.

But Honor soon discovers that even those close to her can't be trusted. Coburn claims that her beloved late husband possessed something extremely valuable that places Honor and her daughter in grave danger. Coburn is there to retrieve it -- at any cost. From FBI offices in Washington, D.C., to a rundown shrimp boat in coastal Louisiana, Coburn and Honor run for their lives from the very people sworn to protect them, and unravel a web of corruption and depravity that threatens not only them, but the fabric of our society

description:
'Lily.' A soft voice said from somewhere in the dark. My head was fuzzy and my body discontented from my brain. But the main thing was I felt no pain. I felt relief. I wasn't in the rubble anymore. I could hear beeps and distant voices. I knew I was safe in hospital. 'Lily, open your eyes.' I knew that voice. A happiness crept over me.

'Dan?' I tried to say but barely a sound left my dry mouth.

'Hey sleepy head.' It took far too much effort to do as I was told, but I eventually opened my eyes to see his beautiful face near mine. He was lying beside me in a hospital bed. The window behind him was dark. I wondered what time or what day it even was. I then noticed one of his hands was stroking my face and the other holding mine. 'You know how to scare me.' He laughed sourly.

'Sorry.' I whispered. 'De ja vu.' I told him. It was just like the time is woken up in hospital all those years ago with Dan beside me. I had so many questions but no brain capacity to ask just yet. I wanted to go back to sleep. And that's what I did.

description:
Run.  Dont turn back.  Just keep running.  Nothing could happen worse then what happened before.  You didnt do anything to deserve some of the things you were put through, but it didnt seem to matter... Because you lost everything.  You lost your family, your home, and everything you owned.  

Your home had burned down, and the only family who survived had been your mother, who got diagnosed with cancer shortly after.. you had nothing left after your mother left... or atleast, thats what you thought.  You were taken in by a man named Ludwig, who treated you as a sister.  You were loved by all the people you met while staying with Germany, but you specifically caught the eyes of two Italian brothers.

WARNING: Bad Language, Blood, Awesomeness, and a Lemon in later chapters (maybe)

description:
You are the Daughter of William T. Spears. You are out in the human world, Even though your dad William Forbids it, as you have not been trained to be a grim reaper yet...You still do anyways. A suspicious figure seems to be following you, And soon he grabs you, pulling you into a Dark Alley...You struggle to get free.....Someone saves you.......Its a boy with Midnight blue colored hair, Blue eyes......or eye... and an eyepatch....He seems about your age. He's accompanied with a tall male with Dark black hair and in a tux. As soon as you see the boy you get butterflies in your stomach........What is this feeling? Could it be? No. It can't be love! ......Can it?
Hope you guys like my first Fanfiction!!!!! FYI It has slow updates!

description: Cuốn tiểu thuyết kể về những vụ giết người hàng loạt rùng rợn liên tiếp xảy ra ở một thành phố. Phương Mộc, một sinh viên thạc sĩ có khả năng phân tích tâm lý tội phạm xuất sắc bị cảnh sát kéo vào cuộc. Đề thi đẫm máu là tiểu thuyết trinh thám ăn khách của nhà văn Trung Quốc Lôi Mễ, do NXB Văn học và công ty Cổ Nguyệt ấn hành tháng 11/2010. Một tên sát thủ có sở thích uống chất hỗn hợp máu nạn nhân với sữa tươi, hắn có căn bệnh gì đặc biệt hay là con quỷ hút máu bất tử nghìn năm trong truyền thuyết? Cuốn tiểu thuyết với cấu tứ chặt chẽ, tình tiết hợp lý, không thừa hay sơ hở bất cứ chi tiết nào, khiến độc giả bị cuốn hút từ câu chữ đầu tiên đến cuối cùng. Tác phẩm này hiện rất ăn khách ở Trung Quốc, nhiều khi “cháy” hàng. Tác giả cho biết, tiểu thuyết đã được mua bản quyền làm phim tại Trung Quốc. description:
[ EDITED PROLOGUE ]

What happens when our favorite annoying, blonde, music loving, 18 year old Guillotine weapon meets someone worse than his Arch enemy, Giriko? Especially when it's Giriko's sister?

A whole lot of romantic, humorous and thrilling adventures, that's what!

But When did Giriko have a sister? How the hell did Justin suddenly end up being partnered up with HER? What was this spark that the both of them always felt whenever they would connect their wave lengths? And what's this?! A new enemy has emerged from the shadows and was ready to take HER revenge. But, what was she after?

Justin's adventure was yet to begin, with new character's appearing and plot twists jumping out of nowhere, there's no telling what happens in this story. But what you're going to expect is that there's going to be lots of love with both the main and side characters!

This was Justin's biggest fight yet... was it HIS fight in the first place? Or was there something else worth fighting for?

They don't know I'm his little sister. I saw him everyday until he moved out. We where siblings and best friends. No one could break up apart...... So I thought. 

My names Alexis I'm 14 years old and I was born a few years after my brother Kian Lawley. No one knows about me but Justin Cloud Caylen. My parents don't care that Kian doesn't want the world knowing who I am because they are all for it. Kian wants me a secret so no one can 'Brake my heart'. 
I watch Kian's videos and seen what Sam, Ricky, Trevor and  Connor look like. I kinda fancy one of them but I'm not say who or telling Kian.

description:
Tini vit dans une petit ville américaine, aux abords d'une forêt. Son enfance a été marquée par l'irruption d'une meute de loups qui l'a attaquée. L'un des animaux l'a sauvée et depuis, un lien étrange s'est établi entre la jeune fille et celoup . Ombre à la fois protectrice et inquiétante, il rôde autour de la maison isolée.

La mort brutale d'un élève du lycée de Tini déclenche une réaction violente: la ville entière crie au loup, et lance des chasseurs à travers la forêt. Tous les animaux ne parviennent pas à échapper aux balles... le loup de Tini est touché.

Quelques heures plus tard, Tini retrouve sur le pas de sa porte un jeune homme, blessé, au regard étrangement familier...

Infection, it could get to anyone. Where it lurks, nobody knows. The only people who know are the ones who wield it, and no one knows who the 'Ones' are. 
Death the Kid doesn't seem to find that problem, well, a problem. Why? It's only because he's a Shinigami; that's only thing that makes it even more dangerous. The poison that is kept with the wielders is designed to find any Shinigamis that are close by; Death City is perfect for them.
Their desire? No one knows, but most likely to get Shinigamis out of their way, and the only way to get it is infection.
Just remember; WAtcH yOU'rE bAcK~

[I had the whole story planned out and even had more stories based off this, but I've grown tired of Undertale and its awful community. I'm sorry about this. I MIGHT return to this one day, but for now, it's just going to be discontinued. Thank you for understanding.]

---

An AU based off the popular bullet-hell, indie game, UNDERTALE.

What if every memory of your almost perfect life disappeared suddenly? Without the warmth of their hands on your face and their eyes that sparkle with determination?

This event occurs to Frisk after they realise they've been in a coma for weeks. They have an actual human family that cares for them (maybe)... and is willing to give them love and protection. But secrets are hidden from Frisk, and the only way to find out what they are is to team up with a problematic teen and the puzzling memories of their past.

description:
It wasn't a secret that I've been alone since the incident ten years ago, that had me running for my life while they surrounded me with weapons of all sorts, poised to kill a eight year old child. I am different, I am alone and I am never going back. My name is Niall Horan, And I warn you this now before you read my story. It isn't a pleasant one in the slightest. This isn't a Fairy tale. I could tell you that my ending is happy to get you to listen to me. But my ending hasn't come yet. But it better come soon, happy or not.

[Based off of the music video for Titanium by David Guetta ft. Sia]

In Skandia, there is only one way to become a warrior. Boys are chosen for teams called brotherbands and must endure three months of gruelling training in seamanship, weapons and battle tactics. It's brotherband against brotherband, fighting it out in a series of challenges. There can only be one winner.


When Hal Mikkelson finds himself the unwilling leader of a brotherband made out of outcasts, he must step up to the challenge. The Heron brotherband might not have the strength and numbers of the other two teams, but with inventiveness, ingenuity and courage on their side, they might just surprise everyone.

But, in every chapter of our life, we learn from it. Life is the test which gives you lesson… So, if one time you meet again the person you thought will be with you forever but got lost in your arms, don’t expect the unexpected… Everything has changed.”
	I was awakened by Lucy… I can see in her eyes that she’s very excited. I ruffled her red hair. It reminds me of him. My past… Here we are again. It’s been so long since I had been here and met him. I know he’s happy with his own life by now… This is because, everything has changed. “Yuri!”

"Papa?" The little girl looked up at the man who stood before her.

"Yes?"

Sarada grabbed his only hand.

"Can you promise me that no matter what, you will never forget me when you're traveling."

"Of course.... And besides, I could never forget my little girl, traveling or not."
_________________________

Sasuke Uchiha was very protective of his daughter. His one and only child. He would often play with Sarada, but only Sakura witnessed it. 

Sasuke will always watch over his princess, even when traveling to fix what he did wrong.

[SasuSara]

Marie Wilson never thought that she'd be a lesbian when she got older, when she was in the fourth grade, and had just found out qhat homosexuality really was, she ewwed and was disgusted at the idea of it, even though she'd looked at many beautiful women with an appreciative eye from time to time, but two years later, in sixth grade, she grew a crush on one of her best friends, which lead her to become very homophobic in the seventh grade, but in the next year, she gave up, and decided she couldn't fight her attraction towards other females any longer, she'd thought this meant she was bisexual, but towards the end of that year, she discovered she had no attractions to boys whatsoever, and started to date girls more frequently. She is now in her freshman year, she's already had four different girlfriends before, but this one, Beatrice, she was head over heels for, she knew she'd had a past of unfaithfulness, but that was all in the past, she was good now, right?
      Destiny Stewarts has been openly lesbian ever since the fifth grade, at first she'd assumed it was a phase, as her mother had called it, but after six years of only longing for females, she was past thoughts like that, now a junior in highschool, she really liked to go out and party! She was a stickler for a faithful relationship, but when she was single, she'd find a one night stand, being sure to use the proper protection, however when she finds out that one of her "one time only" playmates has a girlfriend, she is enraged, and decides not only that she is going to take her vengence upon her, but also to pour salt on the wound, she would make whoever this girlfrined was, her's!

She expects her life to be perfect now but I guess she didn't understand the whole deal with the devil.

Tên khác : Fairy Tale

Tác giả : Feeder - Rách

Cảnh báo : Truyện đôi lúc sẽ có cảnh bạo lực, máu me và rất ngược, ai không hài lòng có thể  click back.

Summary :

~ oOo ~

"Đồng thoại - những bức tranh mà trí tưởng tượng đã vẽ ra cho trẻ con. Lũ trẻ thích truyện cổ tích, chúng yêu những cái kết có hậu và những con người xinh đẹp. Chúng yêu những chuyện tình ngọt ngào và lãng mạn. Những kẻ xấu chỉ là cái nền để công chúa và hoàng tử đạp lên để có thể tỏa sáng."

Đồng thoại - trong veo như ly nước và ngây thơ như đóa huệ tây.  Nhưng câu chuyên đồng thoại tôi sắp kể cho các bạn là một câu chuyện đồng thoại rất khác.

...

Gã khao khát được cảm nhận hơi ấm của tình yêu ...

Thứ mà bao lâu nay gã chưa một lần với tới.

Cần lắm một cái ôm ấp áp ,

Cần lắm một ánh nhìn yêu thương ,

Cần lắm gia đình mà hắn đã phá nát nhiều năm trước ....

           *      *      *

Giữa dòng người vô cảm, chỉ có mình em trao cho tôi cái nhìn yêu thương ...

Điều gì đã khiến em chú ý đến một tên khốn như tôi ?

Gã tuyệt vọng nhìn khuôn mặt xấu xí của mình trong gương ...

Gã không thể yêu cô ấy , và cũng không dám yêu .

           *      *      *

description:
Our choices are what define us. What determine who we are and how other people see us. 

Seventeen-year-old Penelope Chisholm has always chosen to be on the outside. A bit of a loner who finds her solace in running. Until she meets Gilbert Staal and decides he needs to be part of her life. Sure, it’s complicated but what relationship isn’t. She’s positive she’s found her future, but has to
decide if his temper is something she can deal with. 

Her twin brother, Ash, is her exact opposite. Editor of the school paper. Star pupil. Dating one of the most popular girls in school. Everything is perfect. Until he discovers that his sister is dating his new teacher. A teacher he wants to respect but can’t. He knows he should do something about it, but decides to give Penelope the opportunity to end things on her own. 

They’re both so sure their decision is the right one. Blinded by the rightness of their choice. But when Penelope ends up seriously hurt because of their choices, everyone is forced to re-evaluate the things
that have lead them to where they are and figure out how to move forward with their lives.

When you turned 16, you decided to get a job so you hopefully can leave the orphanage and live your own life. But, the only job left in your city was as a nightguard at Freddy fazbear's pizzeria. You go in and adventure in the dusty restaurant and find something strange. Moving robots.These strange creatures can turn human and ask to adopt you. An opportunity for a new life sprung up that day... and you continue to live with these mindless creatures. But who's your true mother and father in this abandoned place? That's for you to find out!

(Volume 01 of my RubyLeah series...)

Aqours has perhaps only about three months left before their school closes and they compete in the final Love Live. Everyone prepare themselves for their upcoming end, particularly the third years. Meanwhile, Ruby pondered about her future...not just her own future, but the future of a new friend of hers, Leah Kazuma. With both their sisters graduating and perhaps being gone, Ruby wondered what would happen to her. Leah happened to be thinking the same thing. 

Later, as they face each other's upcoming issues, they bond to deal with it. And before long they would establish a connection deeper than their innocent minds would expect. 

These two would fall for each other....and they wouldn't realise it yet....

(Y/n) (l/n) has just transferred to Crimson Scarlet's Academy For The Gifted. It is a legendary school that has taught some of the world's most brilliant people. when (y/n) arrives, she can already tell something is off.
She goes into her classroom, but nobody is there yet. She continues to wait, but no one shows up. (y/n) decided to investigate. she searches the entire school but no one is around. She begin to panic when she hears a scream and a loud crash. When (y/n) follows the sounds, she finds herself in the school kitchen. After she sees nothing and begins to walk away, there is a bunch of rapid knocks and the same scream coming from the freezer, (y/n) rushes to the freezer and unlocks it. 
There runs out a boy covered in ice and freezing to death. His name is Oliver. 
(y/n) and Oliver decide to investigate the disappearance of the schools students and staff. Will they uncover the mystery or unravel a dark secret that the school is harboring?

description:
Una palabra es: un sonido solo eso igual que el molesto ruido de mosquito en tu oído, es un sonido al que le damos significado e importancia.
Unos nacen sin poder decir una jamás, otros nunca escuchan ni a ese molesto insecto y algunos más que tienen todo, pero no lo expresan, ese es mi caso.
Siendo la hija menor de una problemática familia con un padre que uso tal sonido en tu contra, no me quedo más opción que aprender a ignorar no solo las palabras si no a todo, algo que me protegió durante años pero a la vez también me aisló, un lado negativo de esta decisión, uno que no note hasta que un desconocido entro en mi vida tan repentino como el rayo sobre un árbol y tan necesario como el respirar, llego para mostrarme lo que yo misma ignoraba mi deseo de compañía y en especial para enseñarme lo importante de la comunicación, simplemente me mostro mi propia necesidad de hablar.

Hi&Hello Guys !!!!! this is my first na mag sulat or gumawa ng story dito..... bakit? wala lang .. bored kasi tsaka isa ako sa mga bitter ng Valentine's ngayon.. bakit ulit?? nagbreak kasi kami ng bf ko sa mababaw na dahilan .. Kaya ito ang naisipan kong gawin para malibang ako at maiwasan kong maalala siya.. 
  I hope na sana magustuhan niyo po ito ☺😉 sorry po kung mali man ako ng format or wrong grammuar ako.. hehheheh
  This story is talking about a girl name Laica Quezon , she is already 17 years old pero ang ugali niya ay pang 4 years old . Nag aaral siya sa Siton University hindi bilang isa sa mayayamang estudyante kundi bilang isa sa scholar ng Siton . But , si Laica ay pangalawa sa mayamang studyante ng Siton . Now?? alam ko kung anu nasa isip nyo mga readers.. " bakit sya scholar ehh mayaman naman siya "  simple lang.. remember... childish sya diba tsaka may pagka isip bata siya.. kaya medyo di natin masabayan trip nya sa buhay.. kung sya ang tatanungin nyo.  simple lang isasagot nya.. ayaw nyang gamitin ang pera para lang sa edukasyon.. kasi nga diba may mga school na kahit bobo ka or bagsak ka , pag may pera ka .. automatically pasado ka.  gusto niya maging sholar dahil gusto nyang may thrilled lagi ang buhay niya. gusto niya yung pinag hihirapan nya.. gusto niya yung magdudugo na yung ulo nya sa kakaisip kung anu ang sagot ng nasa mga test paper niya. 
   Pero.. sa kasamaang palad.. may isang taong dumating sa buhay nya para sirain ang mundo niya.. kunbaga.. binubully sya ng walang dahilan.. pinagtitripan sya ng walang dahilan. 
   Bitin ba sa explanations ko? para malaman mo.. proceed na tayo sa chap 1 💋👏✋

Văn án:
Ta là viết sách, lại không biết tại sao lại chui vào ngầm đi bị tội.
Lui từng bước nói, nam nhân mặc dù yêu mạo hiểm, nhưng hi vọng có mỹ nữ làm bạn, ví như James Bond như vậy, đáng tiếc làm sai ý nguyện, làm bạn của ta chỉ có một đống bánh chưng + hai cái sống bánh chưng.
Vì thế, tại hạ chỉ còn lại có một điều cuối cùng đường.
Tìm được Nguyên Thủy Thiên Tôn mộ phần, để cho hắn hứa ta ba nguyện vọng.
Thứ nhất, không để cho ta nhận thức Thẩm nhị thằng nhãi này.
Thứ hai, không để cho ta đụng tới bánh chưng, hơn nữa kia hai sống.
Thứ ba, lão tử nếu tái thế thái độ làm người, quyết định không hề cùng các ngươi này đó thật đấu có bất kỳ lui tới, nếu làm trái lời thề này, thiên lôi đánh xuống!
Vì nhân sinh mục tiêu cuối cùng, ta đổi nghề bắt đầu thật đấu, hơn nữa tại đây con đường thượng càng chạy càng xa...
Đào mồ trộm + quỷ quái truyền thuyết + ngôi thứ nhất
Này văn cơ bản đi thoải mái lộ tuyến, viết diễn viên một loạt đào mồ trộm trải qua nguy hiểm, theo một cái cái gì cũng không biết người ngoài ngành từng bước nhập hành làm trộm mộ, vạch trần viễn cổ truyền thuyết chân tướng, hàm thần quái quỷ quái bộ phận, ngụy ngành nghiên cứu, diễn viên sẽ kết giao đến một ít Sinh Tử Minh hữu, trong đó tự nhiên cũng có ích lợi làm đầu kẻ lừa đảo, nội dung vở kịch vẫn là lấy đào mồ trộm chuyện xưa là việc chính, cảm tình cài trong đó, mọi người yên tâm, cuố

description:
cinta? 
Apa itu cinta?
Yang aku tau, cinta adalah sebuah penyakit di bagian terdalam organ tubuh kita yang terletak di sebelah jantung.
Sakit, satu kata yang sangat tepat untuk menggambarkan definisi apa itu cinta. Bagi sebagian orang, Cinta itu indah, cinta itu bisa membuat mereka bahagia. Iya itu bagi mereka yang beruntung, bagi mereka yang cintanya terbalas. Jangan kalian fikir cinta itu seperti gulali. Manis di awal sampai akhir. Blur banget kalo Cinta itu seperti itu.
Namaku Aggie, tepatnya Aggie Amanda yang berarti pantas di cintai dan di inginkan, seorang gadis biasa dari kalangan menangah kebawah, salah satu keryawan di perusahaan yang lumayan terkemuka, dan selalu gagal dalam ber Cinta.
Blushit banget kalo Cinta itu indah, iya indah di awal dan di akhir? Jangan Tanya lagi. Lihat saja mereka yang selalu mengumbar kemesraan di sosial media, kita lihat tak lama dari itu mungkin kabar duka ankan terpampang jelas di kolom status sosial media masing masing memenuhi semua bernda sosial media dengan ocehan ocehan galau tak berkelas ala jomblo jaman now.
Dulu aku begitu sangat memuja Cinta, karena Cinta aku bisa bertemu denganya, dia yang sekarang ini ingin sekali aku enyahkan dari fikiranku.
Karena cinta aku bisa mengenalnya, mengenal kepribadianya, mengenal sifatnya dan sangat mengenal bagaimana cara dia begitu lembut mematahkan Cintaku.
Dulu aku selalu memanggilnya, Jodohku. Ya itu dulu beberapa tahun yang lalu, disaat aku masih menduduki bangku kuliah di Universitas yang sama denganya. Di saat Cinta masih begitu Indah untukku hingga tanpa sadar aku sudah terlalu dalam tenggalam di lautan penuh kesakitan, Pesanku untuk Cinta. LUPAKAN atau PERGI

Maraming bagay ang aking ipinagtataka sa ating munting mundong puno ng misteryo.

Isa na rito ang "tayo", na dati'y panghalip lamang na pinagaaralan sa paaralan, na ngayo'y naging "Ikaw at ako, sorry walang tayo."

Maraming bagay at maraming pagkakataon ang ating matutuklasan sa bawat patak ng oras at bawat patak ng segundo na ating nasasayang sa ating hindi makabuluhang pagaasam ng isang di makatotohanang buhay.

September Gray, editor of both her school's newspaper and literary magazine, just wants to make it through her sophomore year and get out into the real world. Captivated in a penitentiary known as high school she finds it easier to be an introvert and hide behind music and words. 

On her 16th birthday, she goes from being behind the scenes to the subject of the front page story. Not sure how to deal with everything she starts a blog with a pseudonym called "Nicole in the Middle".  Her alter ego is her only sense of control now, and that is threatened when September's blog raises in popularity. Everyone wants to know who Nicole is. And according to doctors, her time is running out. 

Reader beware, for the plot twists will make you pull out your hair. A contemporary suspense story with a dash of fan fiction and a twist of lime.

PLAGIARISM is a CRIME!
I felt an slight breeze.
Nasaan ba ako?
Patay na ba ako?
Sinusubukan kong tumayo pero hindi ko magawa.
Kahit mata ko hindi ko maimulat.
Ayoko munang tingnan kung nasaan na ako.
Natatakot akong malaman na patay na ako.
"We've been waiting you for so long years."
"Come in the world where you belong."
Wait lang sinusundo nya na ba ako?
Bumulong sya pero hindi ko narinig.
A portal came through the walls.

  I never thought it could be real.
  That changed when I was dragged away from my home in Sweeny , Texas.
  When I was forced to become something I wasn't.
  I hated them  ever since. I probably always will. But now, I can get the truth out. I can say what has happened to me, to all of us. All of us who were... drafted, you might say.
  Drafted into a Legion.
  A Legion of Superheroes.

description:
The silence was deafening. My lone footsteps were the only thing to be heard , while the sun set in a city that once held beautiful life. No children laughing at the park down the street. No birds singing or blaring alarm clocks to wake me up for school. This place was once my home, my sanctuary. The beds were once strung with golden lights and handcrafted dreamcatchers. No more bedtime stories from the older girls in the room next door. Mo more late night movies or tears to be shed over empty beds. 
      Now all that's left is scraps and rubble. The beds are torn to shreds and artwork no longer adorns the walls. Now all that's left is a memory as I sit in silence in a place I once called home.

description:
Aries Motenire,a 23 years old lady.Maganda at  mayaman.Panganay sa apat na magkakapatid.Pareho silang mga dependent ng mga kapatid niya.They chose to live dependently than to live like a princess.Ayaw nilang umasa sa mga magulang nila.
"Dapat matuto tayong buhayin ang sarili natin.H'wag yung iaasa natin lahat kay Mom at Dad lahat ng needs natin"
Iyan ang mga katagang palaging sinasabi ni Aries sa mga nakababatang kapatid niya.Bagama't pasaway ang bunso nilang si Izra,pilit pa rin nila itong iniintindi sa kadahilanang college student lamang ito.
Nagtatrabaho si Aries sa isang malaking kompanya as a secretary.Para sa kanya,mahirap ang kanyang trabaho sapagkat maraming utos ang nakaatang sa kanya.Encode here and there,appointment here and there,at ang mga tambak na papeles na pinapagawa ng boss niyang walang ibang ginawa kundi ang landiin ang mga empleyado niya.Si Stephen Kim.Ang boss niya.Hindi niya alam kung bakit hindi niya magawang umalis sa kompanyang pinagtatrabahuhan niya.Malaki rin naman ang kanyang sweldo ngunit halos siya na ang gumagawa ng mga bagay na dapat si Sir Stephen ang gumagawa.
"This is my job,so,I have to do this" palaging sinasabi ni Aries sa kapatid niyang si Jen.Ang pangalawa sa apat.Tanging si Jen lang ang nakakaintindi sa mga desisyon niya.Kaya kahit na nahihirapan siya sa trabaho niya tinatanggap niya pa rin ito.

BUT

Isang araw,nagising na lamang siya sa tabi ng boss niya.

Hindi niya alam ang nangyari .


Ano kaya ang mga mangyayari pagkatapos ng nangyari sa kanila ng boss niya?Yun ay kung may nangyari nga ba.

description:
Blanc Kingdom Academy!!!
It's divided to different classes for different rankings;

Qurreus-  classes for the royalties and those who wish to be part of it as long as someone in the position already funds the student. only recognized by their badges.
-silver wing- students who's parents/guardians are viscount/viscountess and baron/baroness
- bronze wing- students from the family of earl/countess and marquees/marchioness 
-Gold wing- purely from the bloodline of king and queen meaning they are the Prince and princesses  they also posses  special magical powers

Idohr- classes for the future Baronets, knight and soldier for the kingdom. only the King and Queen may bless them their positions after they graduated

Tefsiara- classes of aspiring priest, archbishops and etc. , tho they are in the same academy name but they are staying at the main church of the kingdom 


Throughout their education days the students of Blanc Kingdom Academy must interact w/ one another. Students from Qurreus class specifically the gold wing students only must gain the most support of the students in order to gain the power to be the next ruler of the kingdom,while the others must chose wisely whom they will bow down to in order to benefit from the advantage the next ruler may achieve and also gain the elemental powers the Princes and princesses posses.


The rulers from generation to generation only aims for stable peace, for the outside world of their kingdom is their real and fearsome enemy. The Blanc Kingdom is ruled by the Elemental Kings and Queens the water,fire,air, earth and the King and Queen of all rulers which has the absolute power....that the Golden wing of Qurreus  students aims to achieve


What if... an unwanted person accidentally bumps in? is it an accident...or the clock of fate started ticking again from the ruined past?

"Your outfit is worth more than my whole apartment, or my existence. " Amberleigh retorted sourly, as Gavin troted around the room Touching. Absolutely. Everything.
"Thats the thing about having money," he replied, oblivious to the poison in her voice, " you get to spend it." he touched a picture of her and her sister from a year ago. A very, very, long time ago it seemed.
"Just, sit down. You make me nervous doing that." She itched for him to sit still and shut up for two seconds. He didn't. Gavin decided to make his way to the back of the apartment.
"Gavin! That is off limits, no!" Amberleigh shrieked in fright. Her room was a disaster zone and clothes were everywhere.

description:
She's the campus of our school. Mula noong high school pa lang, wala ng umagaw sa title nya. She's not the ordinary Campus Queen na maarte at pinapatos ang kahit sino.

She helps every students sa school namin. Natulong sya sa SSG at YES-O. Volleyball player sya at MVP sya sa larangang yun.  Kaya hindi na nakakapagtaka kung bakit madaming may gusto sa kanya at madami din syang kaibigan. 


Alam ng lahat ng tungkol sa kanya maliban sa pagiging asawa ko.

Hindi naman sa kinahihiya ko sya o kinahihiya nya ako. I am the son of the owner of this school. And I dont have a choice kung bakit ako ang nag sisimula ng istoryang to. 

I dont love her but she's my bestfriend. We promise na walang magkakagusto sa amin dahil may mahal akong iba. 

At ngayong patapos na kami ng college, pipilitin namin na walang makaalam ng tinatago namin. She is my wife. The Campus Queen is my wife.
